snippet.title: Hell Bug Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400470/Hell_Bug/
Join our discord: https://discord.gg/uJuZvbt6
Music by: https://www.youtube.com/c/krutikovmusic @KrutikovMusic

Our lovely insect roguelite game has a demo trailer now! Demo page will be announced really soon! If you want to see a development process of an indie game, make sure to subscribe to the channel. We will share more devlogs and technical stuff like how to make games in unity or how to make pixel art etc.

We aim to document the full journey of building a game from the ground up — from prototyping and game design to marketing and publishing on Steam. If you’re passionate about game dev or starting your first indie project, you’ll find relatable content and honest insights here.
